weather.returns: { place, current: { temp, code }, today: { high, low }, days: [{ date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', high, low, code }] } (code = WMO weather code from Open-Meteo)

photos.returns: { photos: [{ url }] } (screen-sized image links from the album's provider)

rss.returns: { items: [{ title, source, time }] } (time in ms, newest first, about 20)

calendar.returns: { events: [{ title, start, end } or { title, allDay: true, date: 'YYYY-MM-DD' }] } (start/end in ms, today through 7 days, repeats expanded)
